Lemma
[The heat convolution attains its initial data]

↗ def:heat-convolution-solution ↗ lem:integral-fundamental-solution-heat

\group Heat Equation

If $g\in C(\R ^n)$ has compact support, then \[ \lim _{\substack {(x,t)\to (x^0,0)\\ t>0}}u(x,t)=g(x^0). \]
Proof

\sketch Using $\int \Phi (\cdot ,t)=1$, write

\[ u(x,t)-g(x)=\int _{\R ^n}\Phi (z,t)[g(x-z)-g(x)]\, dz. \]

Uniform continuity controls $|z|<\delta $; boundedness of $g$ controls the complement by the Gaussian mass outside $B(0,\delta )$, which tends to zero after the scaling $z=\sqrt t\, w$. Finally let $x\to x^0$.

□
